Name: FrogID
Citation: Records provided by FrogID, accessed through ALA website.
Data generalisations: Following ethical data publication guidelines, we consider certain frog species, most of which are threatened, as ‘sensitive’ species, and the exact locality of these species is buffered to 0.1 decimal degrees (about 11km).
Information withheld: Very highly threatened frog species recorded via FrogID, such as the Critically Endangered White-bellied Frog (Anstisia alba) are not included in the public dataset. This is a tiny fraction of the dataset – just over 600 records - and the exact locality data for all sensitive species is provided to state biodiversity atlases to help inform conservation. They can also be requested from the FrogID project directly.
